name: @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-locale
description: Dev-time type + minimal-runtime stand-in for the dsh-advisor plugin repo. The real package is private (not on the npm registry) and ships from the host dsh app at runtime; this stub provides the consumed locale surface (ctx.locale.register / bind, LocaleId, LocaleSnapshot, the cordis Context.locale merge). Mirrors dsh-private commit b8343cb (2026-08-09 snapshot).
